description: This file defines data structures related to the rebalancing process in Orleans, including an enum for rebalancer status and structs for reporting rebalancing state and statistics.

classes.name: RebalancingReport
classes.description: A report capturing the current state of the activation rebalancer, including host silo, status, suspension duration, cluster imbalance, and statistics.

classes.name: RebalancingStatistics
classes.description: Diagnostics and metrics data for a silo's rebalancing activity, including timestamp, silo address, dispersed and acquired activations.
